title: Explicit healthy Linux Control manufacturing environment

source_root.description: Exact clean current repository root; must match the executing producer.

state_root.description: Exclusive current-owner0700 manufacturing state; receipts/assets/context remain here.

go_binary.description: Canonical existing pinned Go executable; no installation or toolchain fallback.

pnpm_binary.description: Canonical executable for the packageManager version; no runtime install.

go_cache.description: Existing current-owner Go build cache, reused in place.

go_mod_cache.description: Existing current-owner offline Go module cache, reused in place.

compiler_tmp.description: Private compiler-only scope admitted by the bounded foreground job.

runtime_tmp.description: Private durable runtime scratch beneath state_root; never compiler tmpfs.

preflight_script.description: Canonical current-owner executable additional storage admission script; internal checks still run.

go_max_procs.description: Maximum Go CPU parallelism; bounded foreground affinity must be1..3 CPUs.

go_build_parallelism.description: Go package build parallelism; cannot exceed go_max_procs.

peak_memory_bytes.description: Entire operation incremental RAM peak including compiler memory filesystem; retain30% actual MemTotal.

resource_plan.description: Exactly one of every role. Count all retained inputs, outputs, duplicate images, logs and return coexistence. Shared-device peaks sum.

path.description: Actual existing allocation path. Docker must equal current local Engine DockerRootDir.

storage_role.description: Internal retains30% actual volume capacity; external uses peak plus fixed reserve; memory only compiler.

mount_root.description: Genuine mount point matching kernel findmnt; / is only the explicitly selected internal root filesystem.

mount_source.description: Exact current kernel mount source; never an external-volume alias.

filesystem.description: Durable Linux filesystems for runtime/state; tmpfs allowed only for compiler-memory.

peak_additional_bytes.description: Incremental peak allocation including coexistence/return copies, grouped by actual device.

safety_reserve_bytes.description: At least32GiB for durable filesystems; compiler-memory requires0. Internal also retains30%.

inventory_binary.description: Canonical existing ripgrep executable used by source closure. Private official extraction is permitted; no global installation/relocation.
